name.value: End Of The Line General Store

description.value: A locally owned general store and cafe nestled at the end of Lynn Valley Road in Upper Lynn Valley, occupying a corner with roots going back to 1910 as the final stop on the historic Lynn Valley Trolley Line. The store serves JJBean coffee and espresso drinks alongside soups, sandwiches, scones, ice cream, and its signature gluten-free and vegan Trail Pucks, plus locally made art and gifts. It sits minutes from the Lynn Canyon Suspension Bridge, Lynn Headwaters, the Seymour Valley Trailway, and the world-renowned Mount Fromme mountain biking network, making it a natural basecamp for North Shore adventurers.
